name: Majid
note: Iranian sportswear brand, kit supplier to the Iran national team since 2022 (SportsLogos.Net, 2022-11-09); it also produced Iran's 2026 World Cup kits, unveiled at a May 2026 event held by the Iranian Football Federation (Footy Headlines, 2026-05-15). The brand was formerly known as Merooj. Not rated yet: who owns the company is not sourced. Secondary sources describe it as a private Iranian company founded by Majid Saedifar, but no primary document or named press article confirming its ownership was found.
